_comment: Illinois 2027-2028 QAP, IHDA. Page numbers are PDF page indices (the printed 'Page N of 68' runs one lower). Scoring is Section IX, pp.40-63. A GENERAL criteria set of up to 80 points is scored for every 9% Application; an Application may also elect ONE of three policy tracks worth up to 20 more, and 'are not eligible to earn points for categories outside of their chosen track' (p.40). Coded as add-on tracks on a shared core: default (general criteria) 80, creative_solutions 20, psh 20, targeted_markets 20. Maximum 100 'regardless of selected policy track' (p.40). Hand-summed before loading from the body: Development Team 3 + 11 (a capped group; see il_team) = 14; Financial 6 + 6 + 8 = 20; Community 5 + 10 + 3 = 18; Design 4 + 2 + 6 = 12; Priority Population Referrals 6; Sustainability 10; total 80, matching the p.41 summary's section figures and its 80. Creative Solutions 6 + 3 + 3 + 6 + 2 = 20; PSH 4 + 4 + 4 + 4 + 2 + 2 = 20; Targeted Markets 5 + 5 + 5 + 2 + 2 + 1 = 20; each matches p.42. The p.41 summary interleaves in the text layer and was read from a rendered image. Market Characteristics runs -3 to +3 and is counted at +3. Thresholds (Section VIII) are in IL_thresholds.json.

track_totals.note: 'Total General Points Available 80' (p.41); 'may earn up to 80 points by adhering to the general scoring criteria' (p.40). The overall maximum is 100 with a policy track (p.40).
Add-on to the general criteria; one policy track only. 'Total Points Available per Policy Track 20'.

Add-on to the general criteria; requires at least 15% of units for Supportive Housing Populations at or below 30% AMI (p.40). A PSH project is automatically awarded 6 under the general SRN Units criterion.
Add-on to the general criteria; one policy track only.

groups.label: BIPOC Development Control, W/D/M Enterprises and Non-Profit Participation, capped at 11
groups.source_quote: are eligible to earn a maximum of 11 points cumulatively between the BIPOC Development Control and
groups.note: The p.41 summary splits these into a for-profit team route (BIPOC + W/D/M, 11) and a non-profit team route (BIPOC + W/D/M at 7, plus Non-Profit Participation 4 = 11). Both routes reach 11, so a cap at 11 is exact for the maximum. It relies on the summary's 'team only' headings; the body does not bar Non-Profit Participation to a for-profit team.

criteria.heading: Building Development Experience
criteria.quote: Projects with development teams that include at least one co-Sponsor meeting one of the following criteria will be
criteria.note: A co-Sponsor from the Next Generation Capacity Building Initiative (or similar) or with no more than two prior Tax Credit Projects, holding at least a 25% stake in development Control.

criteria.heading: BIPOC Development Control
criteria.quote: Participants that have a 50.1% or greater stake in all

tiers.tier_label: For-profit BIPOC-led: 50.1% or greater stake

BIPOC-led/governed non-profit or IL-RDA: 50.1% or greater stake
BIPOC-led/governed non-profit or IL-RDA: 49.1%-50% stake

criteria.note: Only one entity may earn these points. The non-profit column has no value in the 25%-49% row. A single entity takes the higher of this and its Women/Disadvantaged/Minority Enterprises points. Capped jointly with IX.C.i.c and IX.C.i.d; see group il_team.

criteria.heading: Women/Disadvantaged/Minority Enterprises
criteria.quote: may also earn two points per unique qualifying entity in this category

tiers.tier_label: Per unique qualifying WBE/DBE/MBE general contractor, property manager, Architect of Record or joint venture partner/co-sponsor

criteria.note: 2 points per unique qualifying entity. The joint maximum with BIPOC Development Control is 11 for a for-profit BIPOC-led team and 7 for a non-profit or IL-RDA team (p.45). A vertically integrated entity in several roles earns no more than 2 (footnote 1, p.44). points_max 11 is the for-profit joint cap; this category has no cap of its own.

criteria.heading: Non-Profit Organization Participation
criteria.quote: can earn four points if the Qualified Non-Profit or IL-RDA holds a majority ownership
criteria.note: The p.41 summary table places this under 'NON-PROFIT TEAM ONLY CHARACTERISTICS' with BIPOC Development Control and W/D/M Enterprises at 7, a group of 11. The body (p.45) does not itself bar a for-profit-led team from it. The stated Development Team total of 14 is reachable only under the summary's reading: 3 + 11 either way. Recorded, not resolved.
